name: Reishi
summary: Antlers under high CO2, then consoles when fresh air increases.
chamber_notes: Original Shrooly reishi LUA used a very long quiet fan period. Match that for antlers; raise fresh air for kidney-shaped consoles.

source_notes.title: Stamets
source_notes.detail: Paul Stamets, Growing Gourmet and Medicinal Mushrooms (commonly cited chamber ranges). G. lucidum colonizes warm (24 to 30 °C). Antlers form in still, humid air; consoles need more fresh air and light.

source_notes.title: Stock firmware
source_notes.detail: Shipped reishi LUA: ~10 h light and a long (~1 h) low-duty fan cycle.

stages.name: Antler / primordia
stages.notes: Little fresh air keeps growth as antlers.

stages.name: Console formation
stages.notes: Increase fresh air and light to flatten antlers into consoles.

light_recipe.why: Colonization is dark. Fruiting uses 12 h and 37% white, mapped from 500 lux in the Corvinus literature table (200 to 500 lux early, 500 to 1000 lux later). Blue is the general photomorphogenesis mix. A 2024 paper found green raised weight and red delayed caps; we do not invent a green-heavy mix from that.
light_recipe.wavelength_note: WS2812 blue is roughly 465 to 475 nm. The RGB mix is an approximation of cited wavelengths, not a measured spectrum.

sources.title: Corvinus University reishi thesis
sources.detail: Petra Maszlaver, Cultivation possibilities for production of reishi mushroom Ganoderma lucidum, Corvinus University of Budapest PhD (2011). Literature table: 200 to 500 lux in early fruiting, 500 to 1000 lux later. 500 lux maps to 37% white.

sources.title: Agriculture 2024 Ganoderma light
sources.detail: Study on the Effects of Different Light Supply Modes on Ganoderma lucidum, Agriculture 14 (2024). 12 h / 12 h at 15 umol/m2/s. Red delayed or blocked differentiation. Green raised fruit weight. Blue is still used here as the general photomorphogenesis mix; this paper did not give a lux number for our white channel.

sources.title: Oregon State Extension reishi
sources.detail: OSU Extension EM 9364, Reishi Mushroom Growing Guide. Antler versus shelf form is tied to oxygen, not a lux number. Colonize blocks before opening them to fruiting.

sources.title: Stamets
sources.detail: Paul Stamets, Growing Gourmet and Medicinal Mushrooms, Ten Speed Press. Used here as a general cultivation reference. This recipe does not take a photoperiod or lux number from a cited page in that book.
